[[File:Alo.gif|thumb]]
Alo is a less common [[initiation order]] than [[ola]]. 

[[Immanuelle]] underwent this initiation order when they were developing [[Lifeism]] which is why it took them so long to reach a state of [[nobility]]. 

This initiation order is common among Incels and Jordan B Peterson fans and is often seen as a reason why they experience so many spiritual difficulties, as it is the hardest order.<ref name="evolution.faith">https://web.archive.org/web/20220726155737/https://evolution.faith/why-initiation-order-matters/</ref>

It is considered the most fun initiation order to many people<ref name="evolution.faith" /> it appeals to those suffering from [[domicide]].

The initiation order of Alo is the order of which the universe forms. Alpha being the source, Lambda being the maintainance, and Omega being the goal. As such when in the [[Alpha Covenant]] and to a lesser extend the [[Lambda Covenant]] one will act in this order in many affairs.

The Alo order is seen as being one of universe creation, while [[ola]] is seen as passively accepting each emanation from the universe

Sometimes the Alo initiation order and the [[ola]] order are seen as a combined order of [[olalo]]

==Excerpt==

{{Quote|
Starting with Alpha can be tempting for some. The creative power of Alpha is alluring. Learning about great ancestors and becoming one yourself.
Without being tempered by the other two it means honouring strong historical and current figures of questionable morality such as Tamerlane. And trying to reenact their legacies without offering others anything in return.
They may fantasize about building a giant empire of their descendants. Being like Abraham or the Yellow Emperor, but have zero compassionate energy to go along with it.
Many people fixated on evolutionary psychology like Jordan B Peterson are making the mistake of doing Alpha first.
People who have only worked on Alpha tend to come off as cold, distant, unempathetic, and incelish. Although they have a risk of Faustery, such people are not necessarily in a state of ignobility, they just have done things in the wrong order and look a bit weird.
Alpha makes it harder to do Lambda because you are filled with pride, and the work can feel less necessary. Alpha can also make you feel powerful and thus above Omega, which makes it harder to accept it.
Many people like Jordan B Peterson and certain occult groups go from Alpha to Lambda. This tends to create competent but callous people with high senses of pride.
Some neopagan groups, particularly male-dominated ones like Asatru tend to sell themselves on Alpha and then move to Omega. This tends to be ineffectual and a product of such people being resistant to organized religion and thus skipping the organizational part of Lambda. The same happens in reverse of Omega-Alpha order in female-dominated groups, because male socialization tends to make people like Alpha and female socialization tends to make people like Omega.
|[[Immanuelle Leonhart]]<ref name="evolution.faith" />}}
